title: FCG Heem Delivers a new single "Closer"
htmlContent:
Florida-based artist FCG Heem drops a new single called "Closer," a follow-up of FCG Heem's recent angles "Not Lit," "Walkin Lick," and "Headlock". FCG Heem' puts together a lyrical masterpiece that doesn't slack for a second on the new song “Closer”. The production captures a great sound that makes you feel the music instantly for the vibe that is created.

Once the tone is set Crafty flows and rhymes in waves, as it washes over the listener with lyrical that gets sharper with every line. Being able to paint a picture with his words that come to life for the listener to go on the journey that he takes us on to keep it engaging.

Stream "Closer" by FCG Heem on Spotify
